items.title: OK select vs Hold OK (long select) semantics

items.title: Camera sort order: Name A-Z (default), Name Z-A, Account order
items.facts: Windows setting 'camera_sort' in {name_asc,name_desc,account}; unknown value -> name_asc. Natural, case-insensitive, locale-aware compare (Cam 2 < Cam 10, accents next to base letter); ties keep account order; compare key name or id. TV: AppState.cameraSort (pref 'camera_sort'), sortedCameras getter used by home list, live prev/next, digit keys, grid pickers and Fill all. 'All cameras' grid follows the same order. Grids store device ids so sorting never moves slots. Dart needs its own natural comparator (no QCollator).

items.title: Rename camera dialog (TV keyboard) with Windows validation
items.facts: Validation: NFC normalize, trim, 1..32 UTF-8 bytes, no control chars (Cc). Messages: 'Enter a name.', 'The name cannot contain line breaks or tabs.', 'The name is too long (N of 32 bytes). Letters with accents count as 2-3 bytes.' Save enabled only when valid and different from the current name. Info text differs: owned cloud camera (role 0) renames on the camera ('shows in the Tapo app'); shared (role!=0) or manual -> local display name only. Pre-filled with current name. Server refusal code -63103 maps to 'The camera refused this name. Use a shorter name with letters, numbers and spaces.' Entry opens via quick actions, HUD button, and F2/contextMenu is NOT used (contextMenu opens the guide).

items.title: SD-card recordings screen: 24 h timeline, Left/Right scrub, Up/Down day, OK play
items.facts: Windows PlaybackTimeline: local day range (23/25 h on DST), recorded segments in blue 0xFF3AA0FF on a dark bar, cursor 0xFFFFC400, hour ticks, seek on release; speeds 1x/2x/4x/8x; day picker max tomorrow; clip text 'HH:MM:SS - HH:MM:SS' local time; event types 1 Continuous, 2 Motion, 6 Person, 8 Vehicle, 9 Pet; empty text 'No recordings on this day'; error 'Could not load recordings: ...'. TV bindings: ArrowLeft/Right move cursor by 1 min on KeyDown, repeats accelerate 1->5->15 min, snapped into segments (jump to next/prev segment with CH+/CH- or mediaTrackNext/Previous); ArrowUp = previous day? Decision: Up = later day, Down = earlier day (today is the upper bound, +1 day max like Windows); OK = play at cursor (starts the PlayerWindow equivalent full screen); in player OK pauses/plays (mediaPlayPause too), Left/Right = seek -/+10 s (mediaRewind/FastForward same), Back returns to timeline then to live. Speed: Menu opens speed chips? (open question). Camera without SD card: empty state 'No SD card'.

items.title: Motion toast top-right
items.facts: showToast already anchors top:27 right:48 (safe area), max width 440, visible 3200 ms, fade TopoMotion.navigation, only one at a time, liveRegion semantics. Motion toast: icon motion_photos / directions_run, text '<camera name>: Motion at HH:MM:SS' (local time); Windows tray rules: only active events, only known cameras, only if 'notifications' setting on, min interval per camera (TOAST_INTERVAL_S) to avoid spam. Toast never takes focus and never blocks keys; tapping OK on the toast is not possible. Optional Hold OK shortcut to open the camera is out of scope (open question). Events come from ONVIF PullPoint (needs camera account) or local event channel; no events -> no toast.

items.facts: Camera sort: tile with value pill cycling Name A-Z -> Name Z-A -> Account order (pref 'camera_sort'). Max remote streams: tile cycling 1..8 (Windows default 4, setting max_remote_streams, only limits relay streams outside the view; grids still reserve slots for visible tiles). Camera account: tile opens a form (username, password via TvTextField, password masked, stored in Android Keystore via flutter_secure_storage, never plain prefs); enabled -> ONVIF :2020 PTZ/PullPoint and RTSP :554; empty -> feature off with subtitle 'Not set (optional)'. Account is per camera (select camera first) because Tapo camera accounts are per device. Must not trigger repeated login attempts (lockout rule): Save does one test at most, shows error, no retry loop.

items.title: Accessibility: reduce motion, semantics labels on focusables
items.facts: FocusRing disables scale with MediaQuery.disableAnimations. TvButton/TvChip expose Semantics button/selected/label; empty-label buttons need semanticLabel (Refresh cameras). New buttons (rename, siren, night vision, recordings) must set semanticLabel.

decisions: Tests live under test/widget_tv/ (Tier 3, flutter_test with tester.sendKeyDownEvent/sendKeyUpEvent/sendKeyRepeatEvent and LogicalKeyboardKey.*) and pure logic under test/unit/; the surface is fixed to 960x540 at devicePixelRatio 1.0.
Timeline direction keys: Left/Right scrub, Up = later day, Down = earlier day (matches the brief 'Up/Down day'); the date label shows the local day and is capped at tomorrow like Windows.
Menu/Info/Guide/F1 stay reserved for the remote guide everywhere (no screen may consume guideKeys); rename and other actions are reachable only through Hold OK menus and HUD buttons.
Sort, names, max remote streams are persisted in shared_preferences; camera account passwords only in flutter_secure_storage.
Saved grids keep the TV multi-preset model (id, name, layout, slots); Windows ViewLayout (25 slots, one global view) is not ported, only its dedup/unknown-id cleaning rules.
Local/Cloud badge derives from the control route chosen by the network lane (LAN found and role 0 = Local, otherwise Cloud); UI reads a Camera.route enum, tests inject it.
Siren and night vision tests use fake clients only; no test or demo build may switch real alarms (safety rules in PORTING_BRIEF).
README must gain a 'Using the remote' table generated from guide.dart rows; currently missing.
open_questions: README.md has no 'Using the remote' table; confirm the table should be added in README (and what keys: include media Play/Pause for playback).
Playback speed (1x/2x/4x/8x) on TV: which key opens it (Menu is reserved for the guide; proposal: Up in the player shows a chip row)?
Should Recordings be a fourth home tab, a HUD button only, or both? Proposal: HUD button plus quick action; tab only if the product wants a cross-camera view.
Which controls beyond night vision and siren (LED, motion detection toggle, PTZ presets) belong on TV in this phase?
Motion toast source: ONVIF PullPoint only when a camera account is set, or also a local/cloud event channel? Need the network lane's event API and the 'notifications' setting default.
Max remote streams range and default on TV (Windows default 4): confirm 1..8, default 4, given ExoPlayer decoder limits on low-end TVs.
Camera account (RTSP/ONVIF): per camera or one global account? Windows stores one per camera in the vault (CAMERA_ACCOUNT).
Does the All cameras grid follow the chosen sort, or stay in account order? Proposal: follows the sort.
Maximum grid size: Windows supports 1x1..5x5; the TV keeps four layouts (max 9 tiles). Confirm no 4x4 for TV memory reasons.
